targets.query:
from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_k6_metric" and r.metric == "http_reqs" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0.0)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "request_rate")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_run_live" and r._field == "medianMs" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "median")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_run_live" and r._field == "p90Ms" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "p90")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_run_live" and r._field == "p95Ms" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "p95")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_k6_metric" and r.metric == "http_req_failed" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "error_rate")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_k6_metric" and r.metric == "vus" and r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "vus")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_run_summary" and r.run_id == "${run_id}" and r._field == "averageMs")
  |> last()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Average")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_run_summary" and r.run_id == "${run_id}" and r._field == "minimumMs")
  |> last()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Minimum")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_run_summary" and r.run_id == "${run_id}" and r._field == "medianMs")
  |> last()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Median")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_run_summary" and r.run_id == "${run_id}" and r._field == "maximumMs")
  |> last()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Maximum")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_run_summary" and r.run_id == "${run_id}" and r._field == "p90Ms")
  |> last()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "p90")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_run_summary" and r.run_id == "${run_id}" and r._field == "p95Ms")
  |> last()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "p95")

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_component_runtime" and r._field == "cpuPercent" and r.component =~ /^${component:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${TESTZONE_INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "testzone_component_runtime" and r._field == "memoryUsedMb" and r.component =~ /^${component:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
